item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 30/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh northeast monsoon will bring cold weather to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. With the monsoon moderating gradually and being replaced by a relatively dry easterly airstream, the weather will improve with temperatures rising progressively over Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will be warm during the day.

Weather: Cloudy and cold with a few rain patches.
Temp range: 12 - 16 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
